anchors.name: ISO 9001:2026
anchors.binding: A voluntary international standard, certifiable by a certification body; it replaces ISO 9001:2015.
anchors.asks: Keep documented information under control, so the right version of each document is available where the work happens.
anchors.evidence: An assistant that answers only from your current SOPs and work instructions, showing the version and page, with a test report of its wrong answers and refusals.

anchors.name: IEC 62443: operational technology security
anchors.binding: A series of international standards from ISA and IEC, in force as a series.
anchors.asks: Zones and conduits, security programmes for asset owners, and requirements for suppliers. AI that reads operational technology data, or runs close to the systems that operate a plant or network, falls within their scope.
anchors.evidence: A design note recording what the assistant reads and that it is read-only, for your security team to review against your zones and conduits.

anchors.name: Joint principles for AI in operational technology
anchors.issuer: Cyber security agencies of seven countries, led by CISA and ASD's ACSC
anchors.binding: Joint guidance from national cyber security agencies.
anchors.asks: Four principles: understand AI risks; assess AI use in operational technology, including the business case and data security; set up governance and continuously test and evaluate AI models; and build in safety and security, including oversight and incident response.
anchors.evidence: A test set and a re-test report for the assistant, run before go-live and after each model or document change.

anchors.name: ISO 45001: occupational health and safety
anchors.binding: A voluntary international standard, certifiable by a certification body.
anchors.asks: Consult workers, and involve them in decisions that affect their health and safety.
anchors.evidence: Test questions written with floor staff and their health and safety representatives, with their review recorded before go-live.

anchors.name: EU GMP Annex 22: artificial intelligence (draft)
anchors.binding: A draft for consultation; not adopted.
anchors.asks: As drafted, it limits AI in critical GMP uses to static, deterministic models, which would keep generative AI out of critical GMP decisions.
anchors.evidence: A design note recording that the assistant answers only from controlled documents and makes no GMP decision.
